name: Faster inbox triage in the panel

pr.title: Dismiss an inbox item without asking for confirmation
pr.head: ac09d3c6ebba4a7e9731428de854ac532208db9a

summary: Projector's panel lists an agent's questions and notices, its inbox items, above the Claude Code prompt. Opening an item's line shows a drawer with its actions on digits: 7 discusses the item, 8 dismisses it, and 9 snoozes it.

Until now, 8 dismissed nothing. It swapped the actions for 8: yes, dismiss and 9: no, keep it, so every dismissal took two presses. Issue #354 found that the confirmation guards a mistake that is already easy to undo: a dismissed item stays in the list for 30 seconds, struck through, and its drawer offers restore on the same 8.

This pull request makes an item's dismiss act on the first press. A pull request's dismiss PR keeps its confirmation, because a dismissed pull request leaves the panel at once and only project loop restore brings it back. It is the bottom layer of a stack: #357 lists the inbox newest first, and #358 collapses items by kind.

cards.title: Terms on this page
cards.html:
• Drawer: the lines that open under an item or pull request in the panel, holding its options and actions.
  • Asked question: what a drawer shows in its actions' place while it waits for a choice, such as the snooze lengths. The panelAsked atom records it.
  • Focus ring: Claude Code's highlight on the panel line that has the keyboard.

cards.title: Review so far
cards.html: A Projector review of ac09d3c found the head clean, with the full gate passing, and listed two suggestions: reword forgetAsked's comment, and strengthen a test so it covers forgetAsked's resolved branch.

groups.title: Dismiss acts on the first press
groups.kicker: The item drawer's dismiss line calls the CLI directly, and the item confirmation is gone.
intro: In hooks/register.tsx, each item's drawer builds its action lines. The dismiss line used to record a dismiss question in panelAsked, and the drawer then drew a confirmation list in place of its actions. Now the line's press calls act, which runs project inbox dismiss, replaces the item in the panel's list, and closes the drawer.

The confirmation list and the branch that drew it are removed. An item's drawer now asks only one question, how long to snooze. The pull request drawer's own confirmation, further down the file, is unchanged.

files.note: Item dismiss calls act at once; the item confirmation is removed; forgetAsked's comment is updated.

checks.text: A quick second 8 does nothing. act keeps the item's ref in acting until it has replaced the item and closed the drawer, so a press on the restore line, drawn for a moment between the two, returns without running inbox restore. Checked by reading act at this head.

The comment's earlier sentence still says forgetAsked forgets "either question once the item is resolved", but an item's drawer now asks only how long to snooze. The review lists rewording it as a suggestion.

groups.title: Tests follow the one-press dismiss
groups.kicker: Item tests drop the confirm press, and the keyboard check moves to the pull request's confirmation.
intro: Every test that dismissed an item pressed dismiss and then confirm. Each now presses dismiss alone. The renamed test checks that an item's and a notice's 8 run inbox dismiss at once, that restore and unsnooze act at once, and that a pull request's dismiss still asks.
The test that a snoozed item's dismiss confirmation survives an unrelated store read is deleted, since items no longer confirm.

checks.text: claude plugin test . reports 149 pass and 0 fail at this head, and the rest of the repository's gate passes too.

files.note: Drops each item's confirm press, rewrites the dismiss test, and deletes the snoozed-confirmation test.

checks.text: This block no longer asks anything before the terminal dismisses the item, and it restores through the panel, whose restore line clears the asked question itself. So no test covers forgetAsked's resolved branch, here or at the base: replacing item.answer !== undefined with false passes every test. Pressing snooze:1 first and restoring from a terminal makes this block fail under that mutation.

groups.title: Docs and the inbox plan
groups.kicker: The panel docs describe the one-press dismiss, and plan § 24 records it.
intro: docs/plugins.md now says that dismiss, restore, and unsnooze act at once, and that you undo a dismissal with restore while the item is still listed. The confirmation's description moves to dismiss PR, the one action that still asks.
The inbox plan gains § 24, which supersedes § 18's confirmation for items. The plan stays completed, and no earlier section is renumbered.

files.note: Moves the confirmation's description to dismiss PR and says item actions act at once.
Appends § 24, Dismiss an item at once, with its evidence table.
